title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction
A well-planned diet is essential for a healthy pregnancy. The right foods can help prevent complications and support the growth of the fetus. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that fit pregnancy nutrition goals, providing you with practical ways to build balanced plates.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are good for pregnancy:
* Oats: rich in fiber, helping to prevent constipation and support heart health
* Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting bone and tooth health
* Lentils: rich in iron, helping to prevent anemia and support fetal growth
* Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting brain and eye development
* Eggs: rich in protein, supporting fetal growth
* Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting overall health

## Building Balanced Plates
To create a balanced diet, you can combine these pantry staples into your daily meals. Here are some suggestions:
* Breakfast: oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit
* Lunch: leafy green salad with lentils, eggs, and low-mercury salmon
* Dinner: leafy green soup with oats and chicken

## Food Safety During Pregnancy
Food safety is crucial during pregnancy. Here are some key considerations:
* Avoid eating raw or undercooked foods, such as sushi or raw meat
* Avoid eating foods high in mercury, such as shark or swordfish
* Avoid eating foods that may contain listeria, such as soft cheese or deli meats
* Ensure that foods are cooked to a safe temperature, such as 165°F for chicken

## Conclusion
A well-planned diet is essential for a healthy pregnancy. By choosing the right foods and following food safety guidelines, you can help prevent complications and support the growth of your baby. We hope this article has provided you with practical ways to build balanced plates during pregnancy.
